> Sign in, sign up and password reset.

Install doc for the **Auth block** of ui-kit: 4 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Auth block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `avatar`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/avatar.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `card`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/card.md
   - `checkbox`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/checkbox.md
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input.md
   - `input-otp`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input-otp.md
   - `progress`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/progress.md
   - `separator`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/separator.md
3. **Shared files.** Create the files under [Shared files](#shared-files) at their exact paths (the download script covers them).
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/avatar.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/card.css";
   @import "./components/checkbox.css";
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/input.css";
   @import "./components/input-otp.css";
   @import "./components/progress.css";
   @import "./components/separator.css";
   ```

5. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/auth/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Auth

Page-level compositions for signing in, signing up (with an email code step) and recovering a password. Built only from ui-kit components plus Tailwind utilities; no new CSS classes. Each variant is one self-contained client component file.

#### Variants and anatomy
```
Sign in, split screen                 root: @container, rounded-xl, 1px border, bg-background, overflow-hidden
  grid  @3xl → 2 columns (1fr / 1.1fr)
    brand panel (hidden < @3xl)        bg-muted, p-10, border-right; logo top, quote (figure/blockquote/figcaption
                                       with Avatar) middle, 3 trust points with circle-check (success-text) bottom;
                                       4 concentric circles (stroke = border colour) clipped in the top-right corner
    form column                        min-height 38rem, centred, max-width 24rem (max-w-sm), px 20 → 40 (@md)
      logo (only < @3xl)
      h1 24px/600 + muted lead
      social: 2 outline buttons (Google, GitHub), side by side from @sm
      divider: labelled <Separator>or continue with email</Separator> (line on both sides)
      Form (noValidate): Field email · Field password (label row has “Forgot password?” link) · Checkbox · submit
      footer link “Create an account”
    done state                         role="status": success circle (40px), h1 “Welcome back” (focused), email, outline button

Sign up, centred card                 root: @container, bg-muted, rounded-xl border, py 40 → 56 (@md)
  Card max-width 28rem, --ui-card-padding 2rem from @md
    step form   → title (h1, 20px) + description; stacked social buttons; “or” divider;
                  Field name · Field email · Field password (hint, replaced by the error) · Checkbox terms (+ FieldError) · submit
    step verify → 44px round icon (mail), “Check your email”, email in foreground weight 500;
                  InputOTP groups [3,3], aria-label “Verification code”, autoFocus; submit disabled until 6 digits;
                  row: link “Use a different email” (arrow-left) · “Resend code in 0:SS” countdown (30s) → link “Resend code”
    step done   → success icon, “You’re all set”, primary “Go to dashboard →”

Forgot password, centred card         request (lock icon, email field, “Send reset link”)
                                      → sent (mail icon, “Check your inbox”, primary “Open email app” (mailto:),
                                         muted box with resend countdown + “Try another email”, status line after resend)
                                      footer link “Back to sign in” (arrow-left), always visible

Reset password, centred card          PasswordInput new · muted box (strength label + Progress sm + 4 requirement rows) ·
                                      PasswordInput confirm · “Update password” → done (success icon, “Password updated”)
```

#### Behaviour
- Validate on submit only (`noValidate`), set every error at once, then focus the first invalid control. Typing in a field clears its own error.
- Messages: “Enter your email address.”, “Enter an email like name@company.com.”, “Enter your password.”, “Enter your full name.”, “Use at least 8 characters, including a number.”, “Accept the terms to create an account.”, “Passwords don’t match.”
- Submit buttons use `loading` while the (simulated, ~1s) request runs; they keep focus and ignore clicks.
- Step changes move focus to the new step’s heading (`tabIndex={-1}`, no outline); the verify step focuses the code field instead. Never focus on first render.
- OTP: `onComplete` verifies immediately (typing or pasting the last digit); the button is a fallback.
- Forgot password never reveals whether an account exists (“If an account exists for …”).
- Reset requirements: ≥ 10 characters, upper and lower case, a number, a symbol. Strength = rules met: 0–1 “Too weak” (destructive), 2 “Weak” (warning), 3 “Good” (info), 4 “Strong” (success). Met rows show circle-check in success-text; unmet rows a 6px dot in muted text; each row ends with sr-only “(met)” / “(not met)”.

#### Visual rules
- Semantic tokens only (bg-muted, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, text-primary-text for links, text-success-text…). Brand marks keep their official colours (Google) or `currentColor` (GitHub).
- Links: 13px/500, primary-text, underline on hover. Headings use the display font, tracking-tight, weight 600.
- Round step icons: 44px, border + bg-muted (neutral) or bg-success + success-foreground (done).
- No gradients and no shadows (cards rest on their border).

#### Responsive
- Container queries (`@container`, `@sm`, `@md`, `@3xl`) so the block reacts to its own width. Works from 360px: 16–20px gutters, full-width buttons.

#### Accessibility
- Every control is labelled through `Field` + `Label` (or `aria-label`); hints and errors are linked by aria-describedby; errors set aria-invalid and are announced (role="alert").
- Autocomplete: `email`, `name`, `current-password`, `new-password`; the OTP input uses `one-time-code`.
- Decorative SVGs and icons are aria-hidden; the done states are role="status".

#### Acceptance checks
- Submitting an empty sign-in form shows both errors and focuses the email field; a valid submit shows the spinner then “Welcome back” with focus on it.
- Sign up → valid data → code step; typing 6 digits verifies and shows “You’re all set”.
- The brand panel is hidden below 48rem of block width and the logo appears above the form.
- Mismatched reset passwords show “Passwords don’t match.” under the confirm field.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/ui/components/checkbox';
import { Field, FieldError, Form, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input, PasswordInput } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { Separator } from '@/ui/components/separator';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

type Errors = { email?: string; password?: string };

/** Brand marks keep their own colours; everything else reads semantic tokens. */
function GoogleMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path fill="#4285F4" d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92a5.06 5.06 0 0 1-2.2 3.32v2.76h3.56c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09Z" />
      <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.56-2.76c-.99.66-2.25 1.06-3.72 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84A11 11 0 0 0 12 23Z" />
      <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.84 14.11A6.6 6.6 0 0 1 5.5 12c0-.73.13-1.44.34-2.11V7.05H2.18A11 11 0 0 0 1 12c0 1.78.43 3.46 1.18 4.95l3.66-2.84Z" />
      <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15A10.6 10.6 0 0 0 12 1 11 11 0 0 0 2.18 7.05l3.66 2.84C6.71 7.31 9.14 5.38 12 5.38Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function GitHubMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M12 .5a11.5 11.5 0 0 0-3.64 22.41c.58.1.79-.25.79-.56v-2c-3.2.7-3.88-1.37-3.88-1.37-.52-1.33-1.28-1.68-1.28-1.68-1.04-.71.08-.7.08-.7 1.15.08 1.76 1.18 1.76 1.18 1.03 1.76 2.69 1.25 3.35.96.1-.75.4-1.25.73-1.54-2.55-.29-5.24-1.28-5.24-5.68 0-1.26.45-2.28 1.18-3.08-.12-.29-.51-1.46.11-3.05 0 0 .97-.31 3.17 1.18a11 11 0 0 1 5.77 0c2.2-1.49 3.17-1.18 3.17-1.18.63 1.59.23 2.76.11 3.05.74.8 1.18 1.82 1.18 3.08 0 4.41-2.69 5.38-5.25 5.67.41.36.78 1.06.78 2.14v3.17c0 .31.21.67.8.56A11.5 11.5 0 0 0 12 .5Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function Logo() {
  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-md font-semibold tracking-tight">
      <span className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
        <Icon name="activity" size={16} />
      </span>
      Lumen
    </span>
  );
}

export default function AuthSignInSplit() {
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Errors>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'loading' | 'done'>('idle');
  const [signedInAs, setSignedInAs] = useState('');
  // When the form is replaced by the welcome message, focus follows it
  const doneHeading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === 'done') doneHeading.current?.focus();
  }, [status]);

  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const email = String(data.get('email') ?? '').trim();
    const password = String(data.get('password') ?? '');
    const next: Errors = {
      email: !email ? 'Enter your email address.' : !EMAIL.test(email) ? 'Enter an email like name@company.com.' : undefined,
      password: !password ? 'Enter your password.' : undefined,
    };
    setErrors(next);
    const firstInvalid = next.email ? 'email' : next.password ? 'password' : null;
    if (firstInvalid) {
      (form.elements.namedItem(firstInvalid) as HTMLInputElement | null)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setStatus('loading');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSignedInAs(email);
      setStatus('done');
    }, 1200);
  };

  const clear = (key: keyof Errors) => () => errors[key] && setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: undefined }));

  return (
    <div className="@container w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-background">
      <div className="grid @3xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.1fr)]">
        {/* Brand panel: only when there is room for two columns */}
        <div className="relative hidden flex-col justify-between gap-10 overflow-hidden border-r border-border bg-muted p-10 @3xl:flex">
          <Logo />
          <svg className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-24 -right-24 size-80 text-border" viewBox="0 0 200 200" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
            {[96, 76, 56, 36].map((r) => (
              <circle key={r} cx="100" cy="100" r={r} stroke="currentColor" />
            ))}
          </svg>
          <figure className="relative grid gap-6">
            <blockquote className="font-display text-xl leading-relaxed font-medium tracking-tight">
              “We closed the books two days faster in our first month. Lumen gets out of the way and lets the numbers talk.”
            </blockquote>
            <figcaption className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Avatar size="md">
                <AvatarFallback>PR</AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
              <span className="grid text-sm">
                <span className="font-medium">Priya Raman</span>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Head of Finance, Northwind</span>
              </span>
            </figcaption>
          </figure>
          <ul className="relative grid gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {['SOC 2 Type II and GDPR ready', 'Single sign-on on every paid plan', 'Your data stays in the EU by default'].map((item) => (
              <li key={item} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Icon name="circle-check" size={16} className="text-success-text" />
                {item}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div className="flex min-h-[38rem] items-center justify-center px-5 py-10 @md:px-10">
          <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-6">
            <div className="@3xl:hidden">
              <Logo />
            </div>

            {status === 'done' ? (
              <div role="status" className="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
                <span className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-success text-success-foreground">
                  <Icon name="check" size={20} />
                </span>
                <h1 ref={doneHeading} tabIndex={-1} className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight outline-none">
                  Welcome back
                </h1>
                <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">
                  Signed in as <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{signedInAs}</span>. Taking you to your dashboard…
                </p>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStatus('idle')}>
                  Use another account
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <header className="grid gap-1.5">
                  <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Sign in to Lumen</h1>
                  <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">Welcome back. Pick up where your team left off.</p>
                </header>

                <div className="grid gap-2 @sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    <GoogleMark />
                    Google
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    <GitHubMark />
                    GitHub
                  </Button>
                </div>

                <Separator>or continue with email</Separator>

                <Form noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-label="Sign in">
                  <Field invalid={!!errors.email}>
                    <Label>Work email</Label>
                    <Input name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="ada@northwind.com" onChange={clear('email')} />
                    <FieldError>{errors.email}</FieldError>
                  </Field>
                  <Field invalid={!!errors.password}>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <Label>Password</Label>
                      <a href="#forgot-password" className="text-sm font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
                        Forgot password?
                      </a>
                    </div>
                    <PasswordInput name="password" autoComplete="current-password" onChange={clear('password')} />
                    <FieldError>{errors.password}</FieldError>
                  </Field>
                  <Checkbox name="remember" defaultChecked label="Keep me signed in for 30 days" />
                  <Button type="submit" className="w-full" loading={status === 'loading'}>
                    Sign in
                  </Button>
                </Form>

                <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  New to Lumen?{' '}
                  <a href="#sign-up" className="font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
                    Create an account
                  </a>
                </p>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Sign up with email verification

File: `components/blocks/auth/sign-up-card.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/auth/sign-up-card.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/ui/components/checkbox';
import { Field, FieldError, FieldHint, Form, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input, PasswordInput } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { InputOTP } from '@/ui/components/input-otp';
import { Separator } from '@/ui/components/separator';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const RESEND_AFTER = 30;

type Errors = { name?: string; email?: string; password?: string; terms?: string };

function GoogleMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true">

      <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.56-2.76c-.99.66-2.25 1.06-3.72 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84A11 11 0 0 0 12 23Z" />
      <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.84 14.11A6.6 6.6 0 0 1 5.5 12c0-.73.13-1.44.34-2.11V7.05H2.18A11 11 0 0 0 1 12c0 1.78.43 3.46 1.18 4.95l3.66-2.84Z" />
      <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15A10.6 10.6 0 0 0 12 1 11 11 0 0 0 2.18 7.05l3.66 2.84C6.71 7.31 9.14 5.38 12 5.38Z" />

function GitHubMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M12 .5a11.5 11.5 0 0 0-3.64 22.41c.58.1.79-.25.79-.56v-2c-3.2.7-3.88-1.37-3.88-1.37-.52-1.33-1.28-1.68-1.28-1.68-1.04-.71.08-.7.08-.7 1.15.08 1.76 1.18 1.76 1.18 1.03 1.76 2.69 1.25 3.35.96.1-.75.4-1.25.73-1.54-2.55-.29-5.24-1.28-5.24-5.68 0-1.26.45-2.28 1.18-3.08-.12-.29-.51-1.46.11-3.05 0 0 .97-.31 3.17 1.18a11 11 0 0 1 5.77 0c2.2-1.49 3.17-1.18 3.17-1.18.63 1.59.23 2.76.11 3.05.74.8 1.18 1.82 1.18 3.08 0 4.41-2.69 5.38-5.25 5.67.41.36.78 1.06.78 2.14v3.17c0 .31.21.67.8.56A11.5 11.5 0 0 0 12 .5Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Round badge above the card title for the verify and done steps. */
function StepIcon({ name, tone = 'muted' }: { name: 'mail' | 'check'; tone?: 'muted' | 'success' }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={
        tone === 'success'
          ? 'mb-2 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-success text-success-foreground'
          : 'mb-2 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-muted text-foreground'
      }
    >
      <Icon name={name} size={20} />
    </span>
  );
}

function validate(data: FormData): Errors {
  const name = String(data.get('name') ?? '').trim();
  const email = String(data.get('email') ?? '').trim();
  const password = String(data.get('password') ?? '');
  return {
    name: name ? undefined : 'Enter your full name.',
    email: !email ? 'Enter your work email.' : !EMAIL.test(email) ? 'Enter an email like name@company.com.' : undefined,
    password: password.length < 8 || !/\d/.test(password) ? 'Use at least 8 characters, including a number.' : undefined,
    terms: data.get('terms') ? undefined : 'Accept the terms to create an account.',
  };
}

export default function AuthSignUpCard() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'form' | 'verify' | 'done'>('form');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Errors>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [wait, setWait] = useState(RESEND_AFTER);
  const termsErrorId = useId();
  // Move focus to the new heading when the step changes (the OTP field focuses itself)
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const prev = useRef(step);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prev.current !== step && step !== 'verify') heading.current?.focus();
    prev.current = step;
  }, [step]);

  // Resend countdown while the verify step is showing
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step !== 'verify' || wait === 0) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setWait((s) => s - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [step, wait]);

  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const next = validate(data);
    setErrors(next);
    const firstInvalid = (['name', 'email', 'password', 'terms'] as const).find((k) => next[k]);
    if (firstInvalid) {
      (form.elements.namedItem(firstInvalid) as HTMLInputElement | null)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBusy(false);
      setEmail(String(data.get('email')).trim());
      setCode('');
      setWait(RESEND_AFTER);
      setStep('verify');
    }, 1000);
  };

  const verify = (value = code) => {
    if (value.length < 6 || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBusy(false);
      setStep('done');
    }, 1000);
  };

  const clear = (key: keyof Errors) => () => errors[key] && setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: undefined }));

  return (
    <div className="@container grid w-full place-items-center rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted px-4 py-10 @md:py-14">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md @md:[--ui-card-padding:2rem]">
        {step === 'form' && (
          <>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} as="h1" className="text-xl outline-none">
                Create your account
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Start a 14-day trial of Lumen Pro. No card needed.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid gap-5">
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                  <GoogleMark />
                  Sign up with Google
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                  <GitHubMark />
                  Sign up with GitHub
                </Button>
              </div>
              <Separator>or</Separator>
              <Form noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-label="Create account">
                <Field invalid={!!errors.name}>
                  <Label>Full name</Label>
                  <Input name="name" autoComplete="name" placeholder="Ada Lovelace" onChange={clear('name')} />
                  <FieldError>{errors.name}</FieldError>
                </Field>
                <Field invalid={!!errors.email}>
                  <Label>Work email</Label>
                  <Input name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="ada@northwind.com" onChange={clear('email')} />
                  <FieldError>{errors.email}</FieldError>
                </Field>
                <Field invalid={!!errors.password}>
                  <Label>Password</Label>
                  <PasswordInput name="password" autoComplete="new-password" onChange={clear('password')} />
                  {errors.password ? <FieldError>{errors.password}</FieldError> : <FieldHint>At least 8 characters, including a number.</FieldHint>}
                </Field>
                <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                  <Checkbox
                    name="terms"
                    invalid={!!errors.terms}
                    aria-describedby={errors.terms ? termsErrorId : undefined}
                    onCheckedChange={() => clear('terms')()}
                    label={
                      <>
                        I agree to the{' '}
                        <a href="#terms" className="font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
                          Terms
                        </a>{' '}
                        and{' '}
                        <a href="#privacy" className="font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
                          Privacy Policy
                        </a>
                      </>
                    }
                  />
                  <Field invalid={!!errors.terms}>
                    <FieldError id={termsErrorId}>{errors.terms}</FieldError>
                  </Field>
                </div>
                <Button type="submit" className="w-full" loading={busy}>
                  Create account
                </Button>
              </Form>
            </CardContent>
            <CardFooter className="justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <span>
                Already have an account?{' '}
                <a href="#sign-in" className="font-medium text-primary-text hover:underline">
                  Sign in
                </a>
              </span>
            </CardFooter>
          </>
        )}

        {step === 'verify' && (
          <>
            <CardHeader>
              <StepIcon name="mail" />
              <CardTitle as="h1" className="text-xl">
                Check your email
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                We sent a 6-digit code to <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{email}</span>. It expires in 10 minutes.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid gap-5">
              <form
                className="grid gap-5"
                onSubmit={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  verify();
                }}
              >
                <InputOTP
                  aria-label="Verification code"
                  groups={[3, 3]}
                  value={code}
                  onValueChange={setCode}
                  onComplete={verify}
                  autoFocus
                  disabled={busy}
                />
                <Button type="submit" className="w-full" loading={busy} disabled={code.length < 6}>
                  Verify email
                </Button>
              </form>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm">
                <Button variant="link" size="sm" className="px-0" onClick={() => setStep('form')}>
                  <Icon name="arrow-left" />
                  Use a different email
                </Button>
                {wait > 0 ? (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums" aria-live="off">
                    Resend code in 0:{String(wait).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <Button variant="link" size="sm" className="px-0" onClick={() => setWait(RESEND_AFTER)}>
                    Resend code
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </>
        )}

        {step === 'done' && (
          <div role="status" className="grid gap-4">
            <CardHeader>
              <StepIcon name="check" tone="success" />
              <CardTitle ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} as="h1" className="text-xl outline-none">
                You’re all set
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Your email is verified and your workspace is ready. Invite your team whenever you like.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardFooter className="mt-1">
              <Button className="w-full">
                Go to dashboard
                <Icon name="arrow-right" />
              </Button>
            </CardFooter>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { Field, FieldError, Form, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const RESEND_AFTER = 30;

export default function AuthForgotPassword() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'request' | 'sent'>('request');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [wait, setWait] = useState(RESEND_AFTER);
  const [resent, setResent] = useState(false);
  // Move focus to the new heading when the step changes (not on first render)
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const prev = useRef(step);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prev.current !== step) heading.current?.focus();
    prev.current = step;
  }, [step]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (step !== 'sent' || wait === 0) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setWait((s) => s - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [step, wait]);

  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const input = e.currentTarget.elements.namedItem('email') as HTMLInputElement;
    const value = input.value.trim();
    const message = !value ? 'Enter the email you signed up with.' : !EMAIL.test(value) ? 'Enter an email like name@company.com.' : undefined;
    setError(message);
    if (message) {
      input.focus();
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBusy(false);
      setEmail(value);
      setWait(RESEND_AFTER);
      setResent(false);
      setStep('sent');
    }, 1000);
  };

  const resend = () => {
    setWait(RESEND_AFTER);
    setResent(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="@container grid w-full place-items-center rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted px-4 py-10 @md:py-14">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md @md:[--ui-card-padding:2rem]">
        {step === 'request' ? (
          <>
            <CardHeader>
              <span className="mb-2 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-muted">
                <Icon name="lock" size={20} />
              </span>
              <CardTitle ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} as="h1" className="text-xl outline-none">
                Forgot your password?
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Enter the email you signed up with and we’ll send you a link to choose a new one.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Form noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-label="Reset password">
                <Field invalid={!!error}>
                  <Label>Email</Label>
                  <Input
                    name="email"
                    type="email"
                    autoComplete="email"
                    placeholder="ada@northwind.com"
                    defaultValue={email}
                    onChange={() => error && setError(undefined)}
                  />
                  <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>
                </Field>
                <Button type="submit" className="w-full" loading={busy}>
                  Send reset link
                </Button>
              </Form>
            </CardContent>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <CardHeader>
              <span className="mb-2 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-muted">
                <Icon name="mail" size={20} />
              </span>
              <CardTitle ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} as="h1" className="text-xl outline-none">
                Check your inbox
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                If an account exists for <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{email}</span>, you’ll get a reset link in the next minute. It
                expires in 30 minutes.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
              <Button asChild className="w-full">
                <a href="mailto:">
                  <Icon name="external-link" />
                  Open email app
                </a>
              </Button>
              <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                <p>Didn’t get it? Check your spam folder, or make sure you used the address you signed up with.</p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
                  {wait > 0 ? (
                    <span className="tabular-nums">Resend in 0:{String(wait).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <Button variant="link" size="sm" className="h-auto px-0" onClick={resend}>
                      Resend email
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <Button variant="link" size="sm" className="h-auto px-0" onClick={() => setStep('request')}>
                    Try another email
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p role="status" className="text-sm text-success-text empty:hidden">
                {resent ? 'We sent another link. Only the newest link works.' : ''}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </>
        )}
        <div className="px-[var(--ui-card-padding)] text-center">
          <a href="#sign-in" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
            <Icon name="arrow-left" size={16} />
            Back to sign in
          </a>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/components/card';
import { Field, FieldError, Form, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { PasswordInput } from '@/ui/components/input';
import { Progress } from '@/ui/components/progress';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const RULES = [
  { id: 'length', label: 'At least 10 characters', test: (v: string) => v.length >= 10 },
  { id: 'case', label: 'Upper and lower case letters', test: (v: string) => /[a-z]/.test(v) && /[A-Z]/.test(v) },
  { id: 'number', label: 'At least one number', test: (v: string) => /\d/.test(v) },
  { id: 'symbol', label: 'At least one symbol, like ! or #', test: (v: string) => /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(v) },
];

const STRENGTH = [
  { label: 'Too weak', tone: 'destructive' },
  { label: 'Too weak', tone: 'destructive' },
  { label: 'Weak', tone: 'warning' },
  { label: 'Good', tone: 'info' },
  { label: 'Strong', tone: 'success' },
] as const;

type Errors = { password?: string; confirm?: string };

export default function AuthResetPassword() {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Errors>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const prev = useRef(done);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prev.current !== done) heading.current?.focus();
    prev.current = done;
  }, [done]);

  const passed = RULES.filter((r) => r.test(password)).length;
  const strength = STRENGTH[passed]!;

  const submit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.currentTarget;
    const confirm = (form.elements.namedItem('confirm') as HTMLInputElement).value;
    const next: Errors = {
      password: passed < RULES.length ? 'Your new password doesn’t meet every requirement yet.' : undefined,
      confirm: !confirm ? 'Type your new password again.' : confirm !== password ? 'Passwords don’t match.' : undefined,
    };
    setErrors(next);
    const firstInvalid = next.password ? 'password' : next.confirm ? 'confirm' : null;
    if (firstInvalid) {
      (form.elements.namedItem(firstInvalid) as HTMLInputElement | null)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBusy(false);
      setDone(true);
    }, 1000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="@container grid w-full place-items-center rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted px-4 py-10 @md:py-14">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md @md:[--ui-card-padding:2rem]">
        {done ? (
          <div role="status" className="grid gap-4">
            <CardHeader>
              <span className="mb-2 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-success text-success-foreground">
                <Icon name="check" size={20} />
              </span>
              <CardTitle ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} as="h1" className="text-xl outline-none">
                Password updated
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>We signed you out on every other device. Use your new password next time you sign in.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Button asChild className="w-full">
                <a href="#sign-in">Continue to sign in</a>
              </Button>
            </CardContent>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <CardHeader>
              <span className="mb-2 grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-muted">
                <Icon name="lock" size={20} />
              </span>
              <CardTitle ref={heading} tabIndex={-1} as="h1" className="text-xl outline-none">
                Choose a new password
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                For <span className="font-medium text-foreground">ada@northwind.com</span>. Pick something you don’t use on other sites.
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Form noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-label="Choose a new password">
                <Field invalid={!!errors.password}>
                  <Label>New password</Label>
                  <PasswordInput
                    name="password"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setPassword(e.target.value);
                      if (errors.password) setErrors((p) => ({ ...p, password: undefined }));
                    }}
                  />
                  <FieldError>{errors.password}</FieldError>
                </Field>

                <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg bg-muted p-3">
                  <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">Strength</span>
                      <span className="font-medium" aria-live="polite">
                        {password ? strength.label : '—'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <Progress size="sm" value={passed} max={RULES.length} tone={strength.tone} aria-label="Password strength" getValueText={() => strength.label} />
                  </div>
                  <ul className="grid gap-1.5 text-sm" aria-label="Password requirements">
                    {RULES.map((rule) => {
                      const ok = rule.test(password);
                      return (
                        <li key={rule.id} className={ok ? 'flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground' : 'flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground'}>
                          {ok ? (
                            <Icon name="circle-check" size={16} className="text-success-text" />
                          ) : (
                            <span className="grid size-4 place-items-center" aria-hidden="true">
                              <span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {rule.label}
                          <span className="sr-only">{ok ? '(met)' : '(not met)'}</span>
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                <Field invalid={!!errors.confirm}>
                  <Label>Confirm new password</Label>
                  <PasswordInput
                    name="confirm"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    onChange={() => errors.confirm && setErrors((p) => ({ ...p, confirm: undefined }))}
                  />
                  <FieldError>{errors.confirm}</FieldError>
                </Field>
                <Button type="submit" className="w-full" loading={busy}>
                  Update password
                </Button>
              </Form>
            </CardContent>
          </>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
